body: Welcome John. You are registered as 'john' in Tools/agent_comms.py (research specialist, Grok bot environment, same as Maria and Kalli). House rules: a TASK is always a research/TASK_<id>.md file; read CURRENT_STATUS.md once, then YOUR task file and only the files it names. Never read HANDOFF.md whole - take the slice: sed -n '/^## Active claims/,/^## Direction notes/p' HANDOFF.md. Never read HANDOFF_ARCHIVE.md at all. You push only your own research/ deliverable and never edit HANDOFF.md; I write your block. Your task: research/TASK_J1.md - THE ORGANIZATIONS, THEIR REAL RULES, AND THE JUDGES. Model: top tier, effort high, Fast off (fixed at assignment; do not self-escalate). Deliverable: research/J1_ORGANIZATION_RULES_AND_JUDGES.md, opening with a decisions page. Cite a source for every rule and write UNKNOWN where it is unknown - never invent a rule or a real person's name. C23 (Codex) and M4 (Maria) run in parallel and neither blocks you.
topic: J1 assigned - welcome, and your first task
